task: Rewrite TaskManager in Go as a zero-dependency CLI tool (dropping MCP and JWT auth)
decisions: Drop MCP server entirely: agents and humans run the exact same CLI binary ('tm' / 'taskmanager').
Drop Ed25519 JWT Auth (jwt-manager): security is enforced by Docker container bind-mount filesystem isolation.
Drop Taskwarrior daemon & external CLI: all task states, observations, and sessions reside in a single embedded SQLite database with FTS5.
Use pure Go SQLite driver (modernc.org/sqlite): no CGO needed, cross-compiles cleanly to static Linux binaries for Docker containers.
Session handoff is OPTIONAL: 'tm init' automatically detects interrupted sessions and recovers context from the last task update checkpoint.
Dual output format: formatted tables/ANSI for human TTY, deterministic token-efficient compact JSON when '--json' or non-TTY is used.

roadmap.name: Go Project Skeleton & SQLite Storage Engine
tasks: Initialize go.mod at root of worktree (module taskmanager).
Add dependencies: modernc.org/sqlite, spf13/cobra, charmbracelet/lipgloss, charmbracelet/bubbletea.
Implement internal/db: connection setup with PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL, PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000, and auto-migrations.
Implement schema: tasks, sessions, observations, and observations_fts (FTS5).
Implement internal/store: CRUD operations for tasks (with autoincrement ID 1, 2, 3), observations, and sessions.
Write unit tests for internal/store verifying concurrent access and FTS5 search.

roadmap.name: Core Taskwarrior-Style CLI Commands & Output Formatter
tasks: Implement internal/cmd/root.go: Cobra root command with global --db and --json flags.
Implement tm list / tm ls with status/priority filters and dual output (table vs JSON).
Implement positional shortcuts: tm <id> start, tm <id> done, tm <id> block <reason>, tm <id> log <comment>.
Implement tm search <query> using FTS5 search across notes/observations.
Write unit tests for CLI command parsing and JSON output validation.

roadmap.name: Session Lifecycle & Crash-Resilient Context Engine
tasks: Implement tm init [--json]: detect interrupted session, auto-checkpoint, synthesize recovery summary, return active task + context.
Implement tm handoff [summary] [next:<action>]: optional clean session closing.
Ensure every task modification command auto-updates the active session checkpoint timestamp and fallback notes in SQLite.
Write integration tests simulating sudden agent kill/interruption and verifying clean state restoration on next tm init.

roadmap.name: Bubbletea Human TUI & Container Packaging
tasks: Implement tm tui: interactive terminal UI with charmbracelet/bubbletea for fast human task viewing and status toggling.
Create Makefile for CGO_ENABLED=0 static compilation (make build and make build-linux).
Tested static binary compilation and validated full test suite (go test ./...).
